title: Accenture weighs $1.5 billion sale of China business as AI push reshapes growth strategy: Report
script:
One point five billion dollars. That is the price tag Accenture is weighing for its China business.
Accenture is reshaping its entire global growth strategy as a massive enterprise shift toward automated tools accelerates.
The professional services giant employs thousands of workers in the region while navigating intense local competition and rising operational costs.
Executives are redirecting capital into software capabilities and client consulting infrastructure built around machine learning models.
Multinational firms face mounting pressure to divest regional units that no longer align with automated enterprise demands.
Would you sell a core regional division to fund an aggressive enterprise software pivot?
